root_cause.text: The XDP redirect path invokes master device operations without verifying the master device has been brought up, allowing access to uninitialized per-CPU data structures like bond->rr_tx_counter that are only allocated during device open.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (unlikely(!(master->flags & IFF_UP))) return XDP_ABORTED;` in xdp_master_redirect() before calling `master->netdev_ops->ndo_xdp_get_xmit_slave()`. The CVE description explains that bond->rr_tx_counter is only allocated in bond_open() for round-robin mode, and the global static key bpf_master_redirect_enabled_key enables XDP_TX interception system-wide as soon as any bond has XDP attached, allowing the code path to reach a bond that was never opened and thus has a NULL rr_tx_counter.

The CVE description explains that bonding's `bond->rr_tx_counter` is only allocated in `bond_open()`, but the global static key `bpf_master_redirect_enabled_key` enables XDP interception system-wide as soon as any bond has XDP attached, allowing the code path to reach a bond that was never brought up and has a NULL `rr_tx_counter`, causing the crash in `bond_rr_gen_slave_id()`.

At line 3961, it retrieves the master device via `netdev_master_upper_dev_get_rcu(xdp->rxq->dev)` without verifying the master device has been brought up. bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerability root cause is that XDP redirect path invokes master device operations without verifying the master device has been brought up. In the `xdp_do_redirect_map()` function introduced in this commit, the code calls `__bpf_tx_xdp(fwd, xdp)` on line 2441 without any verification that the forwarded device `fwd` has been brought up. The function retrieves a device from the devmap via `__dev_map_lookup_elem(map, ri->ifindex)` and immediately attempts to transmit on it via `__bpf_tx_xdp()`, which can invoke master device operations on uninitialized per-CPU data structures (like bond->rr_tx_counter) that are only allocated during device open. There is no check for device state (IFF_UP flag) or whether the device's per-CPU structures have been initialized before calling `__bpf_tx_xdp()`. This is the bug-introducing commit that adds the vulnerable `bpf_redirect_map()` helper and `xdp_do_redirect_map()` function without proper device state validation.
